# Moul server

> A Moul database served over HTTP: collections, records with access rules,
> sign-in (password, email code, GitHub, Google, Apple), files, live events,
> webhooks, jobs and feature flags. One SQLite file, optionally replicated as
> a Litestream-compatible replica.

- [OpenAPI](/openapi.json): every route, with request and response shapes.
- MCP: `POST /api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP) for agents; sign in through
  `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` or send the admin key as
  `X-Admin-Key`.

## Essentials

- Records: `GET|POST /api/moul/:collection/records`,
  `GET|PATCH|DELETE /api/moul/:collection/records/:id`. Lists take `filter`
  (the rule language, such as `done = false && owner = @request.auth.id`),
  `sort` (`-createdAt,title`), `page`, `perPage`, `expand`.
- Sign in: `POST /api/moul/:users/auth-with-password` with
  `{identity, password}`, or an email code: `POST /api/moul/:users/otp/request`
  then `POST /api/moul/:users/auth-with-otp`. Send the token as
  `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- Live events: `GET /api/moul/:collection/subscribe` (server-sent events).
- The app definition as one file: `GET /api/schema`; apply one with
  `POST /api/schema` (admin).
- Writes are named requests: send `Moul-Request-Id` to make a retry safe.
